label: MAN UNITED · SOURCES: ESPN
headline: Carrick out. Pochettino next?
sub: United want to trigger the USMNT coach's $10m release clause once personal terms are agreed. His first game would be Liverpool at Anfield on 22 November.
caption:
🔴 Michael Carrick is gone and Manchester United want Mauricio Pochettino in fast.

Sources told ESPN United plan to trigger the USMNT coach's $10 million (£7m) release clause once terms are agreed, with Pochettino expected at Carrington by next week. First up: Liverpool at Anfield on 22 November.

Right man for the job? 👇

label: CRYSTAL PALACE
headline: Palace sack Pierre Sage
sub: Two wins in 10 Premier League games, bottom of the table and 24 goals conceded, the most in the division. Sage was appointed in June.
caption:
🦅 Crystal Palace have sacked Pierre Sage.

He won two of his 10 Premier League games, Palace are bottom, and their 24 goals conceded is the worst record in the league. He only arrived in June to replace Oliver Glasner.

Who should Palace bring in? 👇

label: NATIONS LEAGUE · WEMBLEY
headline: Kane: 126th cap, 92nd goal
sub: Morgan Rogers opened the scoring, Petar Sucic levelled, then Kane's 64th-minute penalty won it.
caption:
🦁 Harry Kane's record night ends with a goal.

In his 126th cap, the most ever for an England man, Kane scored his 92nd international goal from the spot to beat Croatia 2–1 at Wembley. Morgan Rogers scored first; Petar Sucic equalised.

What's Kane's final England goal tally going to be? 👇

label: NATIONS LEAGUE · PRAGUE
headline: Spain: 43 games unbeaten
sub: Álex Baena's penalty and a stoppage-time Marc Pubill goal against 10-man Czechia. Five wins from five in the group.
caption:
🇪🇸 Spain just keep going.

Álex Baena's penalty and Marc Pubill's late goal beat 10-man Czechia 2–0, and the world champions are now unbeaten in 43 games. They've won all five of their Nations League group games.

Who stops Spain? 👇

label: NATIONS LEAGUE · İZMİR
headline: De Bruyne answers Arda Güler
sub: Güler's free kick put Türkiye ahead. Kevin De Bruyne levelled and Charles De Ketelaere scored the winner, all inside 30 minutes.
caption:
🇧🇪 Three goals in 10 minutes in İzmir.

Arda Güler curled in a free kick for Türkiye, then Kevin De Bruyne and Charles De Ketelaere scored three minutes apart to win it 2–1 for Belgium.

label: MLB AWARDS · 2026 MVP
headline: Two unanimous MVPs: PCA and Yordan
sub: Pete Crow-Armstrong (Cubs): 45 HR, 41 SB, MLB-best 10.6 fWAR. Yordan Alvarez (Astros): led MLB in AVG (.316), OBP (.432) and SLG (.607).
caption:
⚾ Both MVPs were unanimous.

Pete Crow-Armstrong went 40-40 (45 HR, 41 SB) and is the first unanimous MVP in Cubs history. Yordan Alvarez led all of MLB in average, on-base and slugging for Houston.

Who had the better season? 👇

label: NHL · THURSDAY
headline: Montreal leapfrog Boston
sub: Five different scorers ended Boston's seven-game home win streak. The Canadiens are 9-0-3 in their last 12.
caption:
🔵⚪🔴 The Canadiens went into Boston one point behind the Bruins in the Atlantic and left ahead of them.

Josh Anderson, Jake Evans, Kirby Dach, Cole Caufield and Phillip Danault scored in a 5–2 win that ended Boston's seven-game home winning streak. Montreal are 9-0-3 in their last 12.

label: NBA · THURSDAY
headline: Wolves win by 39 for five straight
sub: Bones Hyland 24 off the bench, LaMelo Ball 22 and nine assists. Cooper Flagg was held to 12.
caption:
🐺 That was a statement.

Minnesota beat Dallas 133–94, their biggest win of the season and fifth in a row. Bones Hyland scored 24 off the bench and LaMelo Ball hit six 3s for 22. Cooper Flagg, who had 43 in his last game, was held to 12.

Are the Wolves a real contender? 👇
